mzee.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: Kenyatta was recognized at the time of his death in mid-1978 as Mzee, "the wise old one," not only by his own people but by a wide array of world leaders.
firstUse.source: 1993, Funk & Wagnalls Corporation, Funk & Wagnalls New Encyclopedia, volume 15, page 233:

mzungu.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: I have given my daughter to an mzungu, and he says he will make her like the wives of the white men.
firstUse.source: 1888, Joseph Thomson, E. Harris-Smith, Ulu: an African romance: Volume 1:
